==Description==
'''Bloxy Cola''' was an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been bought in the store for {{Coins|10,000}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]. The emote was not looped and no music could be heard while performing the emote, though drinking sound effects could be heard. You could move while performing this emote.

==Trivia==
*This [[Emotes|emote]] was likely based on the [[w:c:robloxarsenal:Taunts|Crackin' a Cold One taunt]] from ''Arsenal'' due to both sharing a similar walking animation and the same sounds.
**The sounds were likely used to imitate the {{RLinkC|10472779|Bloxy Cola}} gear.
*This was the most expensive emote in the game.
**However, it is removed, so the [[Gang Dance]] emote is the most expensive emote you can currently purchase.
*The emote uses the {{RLinkC|10472779|Bloxy Cola}} gear from the Roblox catalog.
*This emote, alongside the [[Mecha Base]], were both only purchasable in [[Hardcore Testing BETA]] and not added to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]].

==Update History==
